title: Viking — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Viking.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Professional Performance for the Home." Luxury tier. Viking was the first brand to bring commercial-grade ranges into the home kitchen. Founded in 1987 in Greenwood, Mississippi, Viking revolutionized luxury cooking and inspired an entire category. After quality issues in the 2010s, Middleby Corporation acquired Viking and invested heavily in improving reliability and product quality. The latest generation represents a genuine return to form.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Customers loyal to the Viking brand, pro-style kitchen builds, spec homes in the South/Southeast where Viking has deep brand recognition.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Viking:

• The original pro-style home range — Viking created the category in 1987

• Middleby acquisition brought massive quality improvements — new generation is genuinely better

• TruConvec convection system for even baking throughout the cavity

• VariSimmer on sealed burners goes as low as 140°F — precise enough for delicate sauces

• Strong brand recognition — Viking is the name many homeowners think of first for pro ranges
